id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

sourcePath.description: Relative file path of the instrumented source code

statementReachedCounter.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each statement.
Value represents the number of times {@link CodeCoverageManager.statementReached} is called.
Note: value will be less than or equal to the number of times the statement has been reached
because if a statement is reached multiple times in one c3 action dispatch,
{@link CodeCoverageManager.statementReached} will only be called once.

branchReachedCounter.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each branch.
Value represents the number of times {@link CodeCoverageManager.branchReached} is called.
Note: value will be less than or equal to the number of times the branch has been reached
because if a branch is reached multiple times in one c3 action dispatch,
{@link CodeCoverageManager.branchReached} will only be called once.

functionReachedCounter.description:
Key is a unique integer generated by the instrumentation to identify each function.
Value represents the number of times {@link CodeCoverageManager.functionReached} is called.
Note: value will be less than or equal to the number of times the function has been reached
because if a nested function is reached multiple times in one c3 action dispatch,
{@link CodeCoverageManager.functionReached} will only be called once.

statementMap.description:
Map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
statements, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

branchMap.description:
Map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
branches, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

functionMap.description:
Map unique ids that are embedded into instrumented code representing
functions, to the file locations in uninstrumented code.

testResult.description: The test result with which this counter is associated.

title:
CodeCoverageCounter keeps track of which lines were reached in the last test execution. There is one CodeCoverageCounter
record for each source code file. This data must currently be fetched from the database.

Refer to {@link CodeCoverage.c3doc Code Coverage} for usage information.
name: CodeCoverageCounter
